title: calamintha officinalis subsp. glandulosa
intro: Calamintha officinalis subsp. glandulosa, commonly known as Mountain mint, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region. The plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include the health benefits of reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Mountain mint include its expectorant and diuretic properties, which aid in relieving respiratory issues and promoting urination. The bioactive constituents of Mountain mint include monoterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
